name: Lethal Ape Legacy
summary:
Lethal Ape Legacy is a multiplayer VR adventure where exploration, teamwork, and survival go hand in hand. Venture through mysterious environments, uncover hidden secrets, and experience exciting encounters with friends or on your own.

Travel across unique locations, complete challenges, and discover what lies beyond every corner. Whether you’re exploring for the first time or returning for another adventure, there’s always something new waiting to be found.
